meta.title: A vendor-specific floor price wins over the default; minimum quantity has no vendor-specific value
gaps: No operation or setup recipe configures default or vendor-specific floor prices.
price_cap represents a bid cap, not a floor price, so it cannot express that vendor A's bid of 110 is refused by a floor of 120.
No operation or read-back field expresses default or vendor-specific minimum quantity, including the attempted vendor-specific value of 5.
No read-back field is available to verify the line limits or that the buyer sees the default floor.
